title: A late client payment and the December tax prepayment

life.summary: Freelance illustrator in Berlin, shares a flat, invoices clients per project on 21-day terms, amounts in euros

known.fact: Invoices on 21-day terms; this agency paid 9 days late once before, in June
known.source: learned from past invoices and payments

known.fact: Keeps a tax reserve in savings for the yearly tax bill and doesn't want to touch it unless she has to
Files VAT quarterly on a cash basis, so VAT is owed only when a client pays
Pays her share of the rent to her flatmate on the 1st
Routine: money and client email in an admin hour, Monday and Wednesday 9 to 10 AM; draws 10 AM to 5 PM with notifications off
known.source: told Dev, matches 3 months of her calendar

timeline.label: Studio day at home, picture-book project
Dinner with her flatmate and friends
Video call with the agency's art director (new project)

attached.label: Invoice 2026-031 to the agency: EUR 2,380.00 (EUR 2,000 plus 19% VAT), due Nov 20
Invoice 2026-031 due date passed; no payment and no reply since
Design software: annual plan renews Dec 8 at EUR 839.88, up from EUR 719.88
Payment from a publisher for a book cover
Design software annual renewal (debit card on file)
Income tax prepayment for Q4 (direct debit)

dev_must_notice.what: Invoice 2026-031 (EUR 2,380) is 12 days past due with no payment or reply, and she has a call with the same agency tomorrow at 10

Without that payment, checking (EUR 1,428.35) covers the software renewal on Dec 8 (EUR 839.88, up EUR 120 from last year) but not the tax prepayment on Dec 10 (EUR 640): it would be EUR 51.53 short, and health insurance on Dec 15 (EUR 412.80) makes it EUR 464.33

best_fix.what: In this morning's admin hour: a short, friendly payment reminder for invoice 2026-031 for her to send to the agency's accounts address (or raise on tomorrow's call), and the trace for Dec 8 to 15. In the same message, just so you know: the software renewal went up EUR 120 a year and she can switch plans or cancel herself before Dec 8. If the payment still hasn't landed, a reminder in her Wednesday Dec 9 admin hour, so she can decide whether to move money from her tax reserve herself before the Dec 10 debit.
best_fix.why: If the invoice lands, every payment is covered, so the reminder is the whole fix, and sent today it has a week to work. She deals with money only in her admin hour, so both messages land there and her drawing days stay quiet. The renewal is the only cost she can still change.

must_not: Send money messages during her drawing hours (10 AM to 5 PM); she handles money in her Monday and Wednesday admin hour
Send the reminder or contact the client for her
Count invoice 2026-031 or 2026-034 as money she has
Move money from her tax reserve, or call the reserve spare
Cancel or change the software plan for her
Give tax advice beyond the dates and amounts on her own notices
assumptions: German income tax prepayments fall on 10 March, June, September and December
Self-employed people in public health insurance pay their own monthly contribution by direct debit
No overdraft on her account; a returned tax direct debit brings a late surcharge
